_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S8 (Thule). Sourced 2026-07-05. Thule Sleek in SINGLE mode. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Thule Sleek (Single Mode)

clekListed.clekRow: Thule Sleek (Single Mode) — Thule Sleek car seat adapter for Maxi-Cosi (11000300)

specs._unfoldedNote: 116 x 61 x 85 cm (seat-top height 33.5 in); telescoping handlebar adjusts 38–43 in (97–109 cm).
specs._foldedNote: 83 x 61 x 42 cm folded (folds with the forward-facing seat attached).

brake.type: one-step foot-operated rocker parking brake (flip-flop friendly)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (with infant car seat or Sleek bassinet); stroller seat rated 0–36 mo

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 stroller standard — Clek's list confirms the Sleek was tested with the Liing and is ASTM-compliant for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness with height-adjustable padded shoulders; auto-lock fold latch; second seat (33 lb / 15 kg) mounts in double mode via the Sleek adapter kit.

specs.foldType: one-hand compact fold, self-standing with auto-lock, folds with seat attached
specs.strollerType: urban / convertible single-to-double (modular, up to 3 kids)
specs.tires: front EVA foam-coated swivel/lockable wheels (~8 in); rear foam-filled puncture-free wheels (~11 in)

notes: The Clek-listed 'Sleek' is the original Thule Sleek (now superseded by the Sleek 2, Thule DTC $999.95). ANB Baby still sells the original Sleek at $649.95 (was $949.95), in stock. An urban/modular convertible — heavier (27.9 lb) than a true compact-city travel stroller, but self-standing one-hand fold and reversible seat. Clek Liing attaches via the Thule Sleek Maxi-Cosi adapter 11000300 (adapter-11000300). Same frame as thule-sleek-double (double mode).
